keyFindings: Spread ordering K1>K3>K2 is absent at init (random graph, uniform K=0.5)
Ordering first appears at Sim(om) — the between-profile mean omega IQR
DL(d) disrupts ordering (K3 becomes largest); Cupd(km) restores it
Within-profile omega, raw freq IQR, and phase spread show NO ordering
Between-profile raw frequency means already show K1>K3>K2 preordering
Sim AMPLIFIES K1 (1.1x) while slightly compressing K3/K2 (0.9x)
Ordering traces back to seed-to-seed raw frequency sampling variability by N
openQuestions: Why does seed-to-seed raw frequency mean variability differ by N?
Is differential profile selection (IsHi filter) the source of preordering?
